lines: 应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。
應對正直的，猶如與人親嘴。
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
He gives a kiss with his lips who gives a right answer.
有些人存疑心，你们要怜悯他们；
On some have compassion
making a distinction
有些人存疑心，你们要怜悯他们；
有些人存疑心，你們要憐憫他們；
On some have compassion
making a distinction
And have pity on those who are in doubt;
凡事都要规规矩矩的按着次序行。
Let all things be done decently and in order.
凡事都要规规矩矩的按着次序行。
凡事都要規規矩矩的按着次序行。
Let all things be done decently and in order.
Let all things be done in the right and ordered way.
你们要互相款待，不发怨言。
Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
你们要互相款待，不发怨言。
你們要互相款待，不發怨言。
Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
Keep open house for all with a glad heart;
要爱惜光阴，因为现今的世代邪恶。
redeeming the time
because the days are evil.
要爱惜光阴，因为现今的世代邪恶。
要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。
redeeming the time
because the days are evil.
Making good use of the time
because the days are evil.
因为出于神的话，没有一句不带能力的。」
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
因为出于神的话，没有一句不带能力的。」
因為出於神的話，沒有一句不帶能力的。」
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
For there is nothing which God is not able to do.
你们的神说：你们要安慰，
安慰我的百姓。
“Comfort
comfort my people,” says your God.
你们的神说：你们要安慰，
安慰我的百姓。
你們的神說：你們要安慰，
安慰我的百姓。
“Comfort
comfort my people,” says your God.
Give comfort
give comfort
to my people
says your God.
耶稣却退到旷野去祷告。
But he withdrew himself into the desert
and prayed.
耶稣却退到旷野去祷告。
耶穌卻退到曠野去禱告。
But he withdrew himself into the desert
and prayed.
But he went away by himself to a waste place for prayer.
人的仇敌就是自己家里的人。
A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
人的仇敌就是自己家里的人。
人的仇敵就是自己家裏的人。
A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
And a man will be hated by those of his house.
不可并用牛、驴耕地。
You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
不可并用牛、驴耕地。
不可並用牛、驢耕地。
You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
Do not do your ploughing with an ox and an ass yoked together.
起初神创造天地。
In the beginning
God created the heavens and the earth.
起初神创造天地。
起初神創造天地。
In the beginning
God created the heavens and the earth.
At the first God made the heaven and the earth.
但要凡事察验，善美的要持守，
Test all things
and hold firmly that which is good.
但要凡事察验，善美的要持守，
但要凡事察驗，善美的要持守，
Test all things
and hold firmly that which is good.
Let all things be tested; keep to what is good;
［新娘］我是沙仑的玫瑰花，
是谷中的百合花。
I am a rose of Sharon
a lily of the valleys.
［新娘］我是沙仑的玫瑰花，
是谷中的百合花。
［新娘］我是沙崙的玫瑰花，
是谷中的百合花。
I am a rose of Sharon
a lily of the valleys.
I am a rose of Sharon
a flower of the valleys.
雅各与拉结亲嘴，就放声而哭。
Jacob kissed Rachel
and lifted up his voice
and wept.
雅各与拉结亲嘴，就放声而哭。
雅各與拉結親嘴，就放聲而哭。
Jacob kissed Rachel
and lifted up his voice
and wept.
And weeping for joy
Jacob gave Rachel a kiss.
你们若奉我的名求甚么，
我必成就。」
If you will ask anything in my name
I will do it.
你们若奉我的名求甚么，
我必成就。」
你們若奉我的名求甚麼，
我必成就。」
If you will ask anything in my name
I will do it.
If you make any request to me in my name
I will do it.
惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
But he who endures to the end
the same will be saved.
惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
But he who endures to the end
the same will be saved.
But he who goes through to the end will get salvation.
弟兄们，你们行善不可丧志。
But you
brothers
don’t be weary in doing what is right.
弟兄们，你们行善不可丧志。
弟兄們，你們行善不可喪志。
But you
brothers
don’t be weary in doing what is right.
And you
my brothers
do not get tired of well-doing.
你们当向圣所举手，
称颂耶和华！
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
你们当向圣所举手，
称颂耶和华！
你們當向聖所舉手，
稱頌耶和華！
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
Give praise to the Lord
lifting up your hands in his holy place.
免我们的债，如同我们免了人的债。
Forgive us our debts
as we also forgive our debtors.
免我们的债，如同我们免了人的债。
免我們的債，如同我們免了人的債。
Forgive us our debts
as we also forgive our debtors.
And make us free of our debts
as we have made those free who are in debt to us.
你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
Don’t be overcome by evil
but overcome evil with good.
你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
你不可為惡所勝，反要以善勝惡。
Don’t be overcome by evil
but overcome evil with good.
Do not let evil overcome you
but overcome evil by good.
